history.text: Portuguese navigators found the islands uninhabited and began settlement at Ribeira Grande.
The islands became an Atlantic staging post, including for the slave trade.
The PAIGC was founded, campaigning for independence from Portugal.
The first multi-party elections brought a peaceful change of government.

worthSeeing.title: Cidade Velha:
worthSeeing.text: The first European colonial town in the tropics, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Pico do Fogo:
worthSeeing.text: An active volcano rising from a caldera, the archipelago's highest point.

worthSeeing.title: Santo Antao:
worthSeeing.text: Ridge paths and terraced valleys crossing the island's green interior.
